title: Configuring Credentials for a Windows High-Interaction Virtual Machine

blocks.text: You can configure credentials for Windows high-interaction virtual machines (VMs) that an attacker might use to connect to the Windows machine.
The supported Windows operating systems are:
To configure the credentials for the VM:

blocks.item: Locate the VM for which you want to configure the credentials, and click the Edit icon.
In the VM Details drawer, click Credentials.

Access to VM credentials and registration tokens is only available for super admins, admins, or users with custom roles that include the Read:VirtualMachines:Credentials permission. To learn more, see About Users & Roles.
Credentials (Username,Password): Enter pairs of usernames and passwords (separated by a comma) without any spaces.
It can take up to 30 minutes for the landmine agent to configure the credentials for Windows.
In the VM Details drawer, click Save.
